entities.name: Saint Petka of the Saddlemakers Church

entities.summary: The Church of St Petka of the Saddlers is a medieval Bulgarian Orthodox church in Sofia, the capital of Bulgaria. The church is located in a semi-submerged shopping mall, and can be accessed via the Serdika metro station.
